# Purpose

MCF7-SIX1 counterpart of `gene_rna_te_hypoxia_si3d_231.Rmd`: where one gene sits, for mRNA
and translation efficiency (TE), relative to every other gene in the same contrast.

**What MCF7-SIX1 has, and what it lacks, relative to MDA-MB-231:**

- **One timepoint only (1hr).** There is no 4hr, 24hr or time-regressed contrast.
- **Control cells (siCTRL), hypoxia vs normoxia, 1hr** - mRNA and TE, `log2(hypoxia / normoxia)`,
  from the other repo's `counts/all_norm_to_hyp_changes.csv`.
- **eIF3d knockdown, hypoxia 1hr and normoxia 1hr - TE only.** The knockdown analysis in the
  other repo fitted only the TE interaction term; no knockdown mRNA contrast exists, so the
  knockdown panel has no mRNA row.
- **Not spike-in normalised** (MDA-MB-231 is), so medians sit near zero and magnitudes are not
  comparable across cell lines. Compare percentiles, not raw log2FC.

The knockdown files in this repo have already been flipped to match MDA-MB-231:
`te_lfc = -source_log2FoldChange`, so positive = the knockdown lowers TE = eIF3d promotes it.
The original DESeq2 coefficient was `log2(si3d / sictrl)`.

```{r libs}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(patchwork)

GENE_ID    <- params$gene_id
GENE_LABEL <- params$gene_label
GENE_COL   <- "#0072B2"   # Okabe-Ito dark blue; orange / sky blue are reserved for si3d / si3e
REST_COL   <- "grey70"
```

# Load

```{r load}
ctrl_file <- file.path(params$mcf7_repo, "counts", "all_norm_to_hyp_changes.csv")
stopifnot("MCF7-SIX1 control hypoxia table not found" = file.exists(ctrl_file))

ctrl <- read_csv(ctrl_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  transmute(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id), contrast = "1hr",
            rna_lfc = LFC_rna_sictrl, rna_padj = padj_rna_sictrl,
            te_lfc  = LFC_te_sictrl,  te_padj  = padj_te_sictrl) %>%
  filter(!is.na(te_padj)) %>%
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast))

read_kd <- function(file, label) {
  read_csv(here("output", file), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    mutate(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id), contrast = label)
}
kd_raw <- bind_rows(
  read_kd("translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_mcf7six1_hypoxia_1hr.csv",  "Hypoxia 1hr"),
  read_kd("translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_mcf7six1_normoxia_1hr.csv", "Normoxia 1hr")
)
kd <- kd_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(te_padj)) %>%
  transmute(gene_id_clean, contrast = factor(contrast, c("Hypoxia 1hr", "Normoxia 1hr")),
            rna_lfc = NA_real_, rna_padj = NA_real_, te_lfc, te_padj)
```

# Direction checks

The usual check (the knockdown target's own mRNA must be strongly positive) cannot run here:
there is no knockdown mRNA column, so it would silently skip. Instead:

- **Control contrast, parsed from the producing source.** `5_hypoxicresponse.Rmd` must set
  `normoxia` as the reference level for the TE, mRNA and ribosome fits. At 1hr the classic HIF
  targets have not moved yet in these cells, so there is no biological ruler to use.
- **Knockdown, the flip itself.** `te_lfc` must be exactly `-source_log2FoldChange`.
- **Knockdown, against independent data.** The flipped MCF7-SIX1 TE must correlate positively
  with the matched MDA-MB-231 contrast (previously measured at Spearman +0.12 to +0.43;
  un-flipped it is negative).

```{r direction_checks}
src <- readLines(file.path(params$mcf7_repo, "code", "5_hypoxicresponse.Rmd"))
ref_lines <- grep("metadata_acute_sictrl(_rna|_ribo)?\\$condition <- relevel", src, value = TRUE)
stopifnot("expected 3 relevel calls for the siCTRL hypoxia fits" = length(ref_lines) == 3,
          "siCTRL hypoxia contrast reference is not normoxia" = all(grepl('ref = "normoxia"', ref_lines)))

stopifnot("knockdown te_lfc is not the negated source coefficient" =
            isTRUE(all.equal(kd_raw$te_lfc, -kd_raw$source_log2FoldChange)))

match_231 <- c("Hypoxia 1hr"  = "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_hypoxia_1hr.csv",
               "Normoxia 1hr" = "translation_categories_si3d_vs_sictrl_normoxia_1hr.csv")
rho <- imap_dbl(match_231, function(f, lab) {
  m231 <- read_csv(here("output", f), show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    transmute(gene_id_clean = sub("\\..*", "", gene_id), te_231 = te_lfc)
  j <- kd %>% filter(contrast == lab) %>% inner_join(m231, by = "gene_id_clean")
  cor(j$te_lfc, j$te_231, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
})
print(round(rho, 3))
stopifnot("flipped MCF7-SIX1 TE does not agree with the matched MDA-MB-231 contrast" = all(rho > 0))

stopifnot(
  "gene missing from the control contrast"  = nrow(filter(ctrl, gene_id_clean == GENE_ID)) == 1,
  "gene missing from a knockdown contrast"  = nrow(filter(kd,   gene_id_clean == GENE_ID)) == 2
)
```

# Table

```{r table}
summarise_gene <- function(d) {
  has_rna <- any(!is.na(d$rna_lfc))
  d %>%
    group_by(contrast) %>%
    summarise(
      n          = n(),
      median_rna = if (has_rna) median(rna_lfc, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      median_te  = median(te_lfc),
      rna_pct    = if (has_rna) mean(rna_lfc <= rna_lfc[gene_id_clean == GENE_ID], na.rm = TRUE) * 100 else NA_real_,
      te_pct     = mean(te_lfc <= te_lfc[gene_id_clean == GENE_ID]) * 100,
      .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(d %>% filter(gene_id_clean == GENE_ID) %>%
                dplyr::select(contrast, rna_lfc, rna_padj, te_lfc, te_padj), by = "contrast") %>%
    dplyr::select(contrast, rna_lfc, rna_padj, rna_pct, median_rna,
                  te_lfc, te_padj, te_pct, median_te, n)
}

tab <- bind_rows(summarise_gene(ctrl) %>% mutate(set = "Control: hypoxia vs normoxia"),
                 summarise_gene(kd)   %>% mutate(set = "eIF3d knockdown: sictrl vs si3d")) %>%
  mutate(contrast = as.character(contrast)) %>%
  relocate(set)
knitr::kable(tab, digits = c(0, 0, 2, 4, 0, 2, 2, 4, 0, 2, 0),
             caption = paste0(GENE_LABEL, " in MCF7-SIX1: log2FC, padj, percentile among all tested ",
                              "genes, and the transcriptome median (knockdown mRNA not available)"))
```

# Figure

```{r figure}
to_long <- function(d) {
  d %>%
    pivot_longer(c(rna_lfc, te_lfc), names_to = "measure", values_to = "lfc") %>%
    mutate(padj = if_else(measure == "rna_lfc", rna_padj, te_padj),
           measure = factor(if_else(measure == "rna_lfc", "mRNA", "TE"), c("mRNA", "TE"))) %>%
    filter(is.finite(lfc))
}

# "*" padj < 0.05, "ns" tested but not significant, blank when no contrast exists
stars <- function(p) case_when(is.na(p) ~ "", p < 0.05 ~ "*", TRUE ~ "ns")
ordinal <- function(x) {
  x <- round(x)
  suf <- ifelse(x %% 100 %in% 11:13, "th", c("th", "st", "nd", "rd", rep("th", 6))[x %% 10 + 1])
  paste0(x, suf)
}

panel <- function(d, title, ylab) {
  long <- to_long(d)
  pt <- long %>% filter(gene_id_clean == GENE_ID)
  pct <- long %>% group_by(contrast, measure) %>%
    summarise(pct = mean(lfc <= lfc[gene_id_clean == GENE_ID]) * 100, n = n(), .groups = "drop")
  pt <- pt %>% left_join(pct, by = c("contrast", "measure")) %>%
    mutate(lab = sprintf("%+.2f %s\n%s pct", lfc, stars(padj), ordinal(pct)))
  n_lab <- pct %>% group_by(measure) %>%
    summarise(lab = paste0("n = ", format(min(n), big.mark = ","),
                           if (min(n) != max(n)) paste0("-", format(max(n), big.mark = ",")) else ""),
              .groups = "drop")
  # Clip the y range to the bulk of the distribution (0.5-99.5%) so the medians are readable,
  # always keeping the gene's own point in range.
  lims <- long %>% group_by(measure) %>%
    summarise(lo = min(quantile(lfc, 0.005), min(pt$lfc[pt$measure == cur_group()$measure])) - 0.3,
              hi = max(quantile(lfc, 0.995), max(pt$lfc[pt$measure == cur_group()$measure])) + 0.3,
              .groups = "drop")
  long <- long %>% left_join(lims, by = "measure") %>% filter(lfc >= lo, lfc <= hi)

  ggplot(long, aes(x = contrast, y = lfc)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.3, colour = "grey40") +
    geom_violin(fill = REST_COL, colour = NA, alpha = 0.6, scale = "width", width = 0.8) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.12, outlier.shape = NA, fill = "white", colour = "grey30",
                 linewidth = 0.3) +
    geom_point(data = pt, colour = GENE_COL, size = 3.2) +
    geom_text(data = pt, aes(label = lab), colour = GENE_COL, size = 3.1,
              hjust = 0, nudge_x = 0.22, lineheight = 0.9) +
    geom_text(data = n_lab, aes(x = -Inf, y = Inf, label = lab), inherit.aes = FALSE,
              hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.3, size = 3.1, colour = "grey30") +
    facet_wrap(~ measure, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_x_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(0.5, 0.9))) +
    labs(title = title, x = NULL, y = ylab) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold", size = 13),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
}

pA <- panel(ctrl, "Control cells: hypoxia vs normoxia", "log2(hypoxia / normoxia)")
# Knockdown has TE only; the spacer keeps its TE panel level with the control TE panel.
pB <- panel(kd, "eIF3d knockdown (TE only)", "log2(sictrl / si3d)")
pB_col <- wrap_elements(full = grid::textGrob(
            "No knockdown mRNA contrast\nexists for MCF7-SIX1",
            gp = grid::gpar(col = "grey40", fontsize = 11))) / pB +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1))

p <- (pA | pB_col) + plot_layout(widths = c(1.4, 2.2)) +
  plot_annotation(
    title = paste(GENE_LABEL, "in MCF7-SIX1 (1hr only)"),
    subtitle = paste0("Blue point = ", GENE_LABEL,
                      "; grey = all genes tested in that contrast (box = median and IQR).\n",
                      "Label: log2FC (* = padj < 0.05) and percentile among all genes. ",
                      "Positive in the knockdown panel = si3d lowers it. Not spike-in normalised."),
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
                  plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)))
p

if (params$save_plots) {
  out <- here("plots", paste0("gene_rna_te_hypoxia_si3d_mcf7six1_", GENE_LABEL, ".pdf"))
  ggsave(out, p, width = 9, height = 7.5)
  cat("Saved", out, "\n")
}
```

# Per-sample values

The figure above shows fold changes from DESeq2 contrasts. Here are the **values themselves**
for each sample, from the per-sample TE tables:

- **mRNA** and **ribosome footprints** = log2(spike-in normalised counts + 1).
- **TE** = log2(ribosome footprints) - log2(mRNA) for the matched ribosome and RNA library.

Bar = mean of the replicates, points = individual replicates. A star means the DESeq2 contrast
for that pair has padj < 0.05 and "ns" that it was tested and is not significant; the star comes from the same contrast tables used above, not
from a test on these points.

```{r value_helpers}
VALUE_NAMES <- c(rna = "mRNA", ribo = "Ribosome footprints", TE = "TE")
VALUE_UNITS <- c(rna = "log2(norm counts + 1)", ribo = "log2(norm counts + 1)", TE = "log2(ribo / mRNA)")

# Bars of replicate means, replicate points, and a padj label above each pair - one small plot
# per measure so each carries its own y-axis units. `sig` has one row per x position and
# measure, with that contrast's padj and log2FC. `x_labels` relabels the x ticks.
value_panel <- function(vals, x, fill, fill_values, sig, comparison, x_labels = waiver()) {
  one <- function(ms) {
    v <- vals %>% filter(measure == ms)
    means <- v %>% group_by(.data[[x]], .data[[fill]]) %>%
      summarise(value = mean(value), .groups = "drop")
    # label sits above the taller of bar or points for that pair, offset by 8% of the range
    off <- 0.08 * diff(range(c(0, v$value)))
    star <- v %>% group_by(.data[[x]]) %>%
      summarise(y = max(c(0, value)) + off, .groups = "drop") %>%
      left_join(sig %>% filter(measure == ms) %>% dplyr::select(-measure), by = x) %>%
      filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
      # significant pairs carry the DESeq2 log2FC next to the star
      mutate(lab = if_else(padj < 0.05, sprintf("* %+.2f", lfc), "ns"))

    ggplot(v, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = value, fill = .data[[fill]])) +
      geom_col(data = means, position = position_dodge(width = 0.75), width = 0.7) +
      geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15, dodge.width = 0.75, seed = 9),
                 size = 1.6, shape = 21, colour = "black", show.legend = FALSE) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.5) +
      geom_text(data = star, aes(x = .data[[x]], y = y, label = lab,
                                size = if_else(lab == "ns", 4, 4.5)),
                inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 0.3, show.legend = FALSE) +
      scale_size_identity() +
      scale_fill_manual(values = fill_values, name = NULL) +
      scale_x_discrete(labels = x_labels) +
      scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
      labs(title = paste0(VALUE_NAMES[[ms]], ": ", comparison), x = NULL, y = VALUE_UNITS[[ms]]) +
      ggprism::theme_prism(base_size = 12) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "bold", size = 12),
            axis.title.y = element_text(size = 11))
  }
  wrap_plots(lapply(intersect(names(VALUE_NAMES), unique(vals$measure)), one),
             nrow = 1, guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "right")
}
```

```{r values_mcf7, fig.width = 11, fig.height = 4.5}
# Per-sample table written by the other repo's 2_calculate_te.Rmd. Columns are
# {condition}_{treatment}_{rep}_{TE|rna|ribo}. There TE was shifted by a constant (+0.7617,
# the global median) so values are relative; one si3e ribosome replicate was dropped as an
# outlier, which does not touch the siCTRL / si3d samples shown here.
mv <- read_csv(file.path(params$mcf7_repo, "counts", "calculate_te", "complete_te_list.csv"),
               show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(sub("\\..*", "", gene_id) == GENE_ID) %>%
  dplyr::select(matches("^(normoxia|hypoxia)_(sictrl|si3d)_[abc]_(TE|rna|ribo)$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "col", values_to = "value") %>%
  tidyr::extract(col, c("condition", "treatment", "rep", "measure"),
                 "^(normoxia|hypoxia)_(sictrl|si3d)_([abc])_(TE|rna|ribo)$") %>%
  mutate(condition = factor(str_to_title(condition), c("Normoxia", "Hypoxia")),
         treatment = factor(treatment, c("sictrl", "si3d")),
         hours = factor("1hr"))
stopifnot("gene not found in the MCF7-SIX1 per-sample table" = nrow(mv) > 0,
          "expected 3 replicates per group" =
            all(dplyr::count(mv, condition, treatment, measure)$n == 3))

# padj: control from the hypoxia table above; knockdown has TE only (no RNA or ribosome
# contrast exists, so those knockdown bars carry no star - untested, not non-significant).
g_ctrl <- read_csv(ctrl_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  filter(sub("\\..*", "", gene_id) == GENE_ID)
ctrl_sig <- tibble(hours = factor("1hr"), measure = c("rna", "ribo", "TE"),
                   padj = c(g_ctrl$padj_rna_sictrl, g_ctrl$padj_ribo_sictrl, g_ctrl$padj_te_sictrl),
                   lfc  = c(g_ctrl$LFC_rna_sictrl,  g_ctrl$LFC_ribo_sictrl,  g_ctrl$LFC_te_sictrl))
kd_sig <- kd %>% filter(gene_id_clean == GENE_ID) %>%
  transmute(condition = factor(sub(" 1hr", "", contrast), c("Normoxia", "Hypoxia")),
            measure = "TE", padj = te_padj, lfc = te_lfc)

vA <- value_panel(mv %>% filter(treatment == "sictrl"), "hours", "condition",
                  c(Normoxia = "#0072B2", Hypoxia = "#CC79A7"), ctrl_sig,
                  comparison = "hyp vs norm")
vB <- value_panel(mv, "condition", "treatment",
                  c(sictrl = "#999999", si3d = "#E69F00"), kd_sig,
                  comparison = "sictrl vs si3d",
                  x_labels = function(x) paste(x, "1hr"))
# Two separate figures: the control-cell hypoxic response, and the effect of eIF3d knockdown.
ann <- function(title, subtitle)
  plot_annotation(title = title, subtitle = subtitle,
                  theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
                                plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10)))
base_sub <- "* = DESeq2 padj < 0.05."

pv_ctrl <- vA + ann(paste(GENE_LABEL, "in MCF7-SIX1: hypoxic response in control cells"),
                    paste0(base_sub, "\nlog2FC = log2(hypoxia / normoxia). TE is median-shifted."))
pv_kd   <- vB + ann(paste(GENE_LABEL, "in MCF7-SIX1: effect of eIF3d knockdown"),
                    paste0(base_sub, "\nlog2FC = log2(sictrl / si3d), positive = si3d lowers it. TE is median-shifted."))
pv_ctrl
pv_kd

if (params$save_plots) {
  stem <- paste0("gene_rna_te_hypoxia_si3d_mcf7six1_", GENE_LABEL)
  ggsave(here("plots", paste0(stem, "_values_hypoxia_ctrl.pdf")), pv_ctrl, width = 11, height = 4.5)
  ggsave(here("plots", paste0(stem, "_values_si3d.pdf")),         pv_kd,   width = 11, height = 4.5)
  cat("Saved", paste0(stem, c("_values_hypoxia_ctrl.pdf", "_values_si3d.pdf")), sep = "\n")
}
```
